symptom: Reopening saved ComfyUI workflow JSONs showed empty canvases or blank output nodes; Studio /films.html could not render image job previews from workflow definitions alone.
verification: Existing seven image-job records and preview URLs demonstrate Studio registration/HTTP proof for that scoped catalog. A pinned LoadImage GUI workflow, supported registration, HTTP media/hash readback and reopened films.html inspection must be saved separately; workflow JSON alone proves none of the later stages.
limitations: Full four-way readback is not established for every asset. Reused assets and imagegen calls may have runtime_id null; native video review uses media playback endpoints.
root_cause: ComfyUI SaveImage node exports files to output/ but does not preserve persistent image buffer across UI reloads. Without an explicit LoadImage node pointing to the output, reloaded canvas is empty.
fix_or_workaround: Resolve the helper under the active episode and create a companion review GUI workflow with a pinned LoadImage node in ComfyUI/input. Separately register the artifact in Studio with truthful runtime_id or null, read back the actual HTTP media/hash, and reopen the specific UI item.
prevention: Save Comfy GUI import, Studio registration, HTTP media/hash and reopened UI proof independently. Do not treat a LoadImage node or workflow JSON as an automatic films.html preview.
